headline: Molten Core in 31 minutes, Geddon and Shazzrah pulled together

mvp.headline: the most damage on five bosses
why: First on Magmadar, Garr, Geddon, Golemagg and Ragnaros, second on Gehennas, Sulfuron and Majordomo

also.text: the most damage on Lucifron, Gehennas and Sulfuron
86 dispels, including 11 Magma Shackles and 18 Cauterizing Flames
the most healing on four bosses

overview: Nine boss fights in 31 minutes from the Lucifron pull to Ragnaros, after Blackwing Lair the same evening. Shazzrah has no fight of his own: his Arcane Explosion and curses show up inside the Geddon fight, which Warcraft Logs lists under a different encounter number, so the two were pulled together.
Two boss deaths: Santamuerte to Lucifron's melee at 0:12 and Firetoad in Yulepunch's Living Bomb at 0:37 on Geddon.

wentWell.text: Lucifron with 23 curses removed (Elozia 10, Firetoad 8) and 20 Impending Dooms dispelled.
Gehennas in 0:23 with Rain of Fire at a quarter of the usual rate.
Ragnaros in 0:50, no deaths, Lava Burst hits at two thirds of the usual rate.

notes.text: 0:30. Lucifron's melee killed Santamuerte at 0:12. Gertggs top at 52k.
0:35, no deaths, both Frenzies tranquilized by Speldosan. Lava Bomb fire hits nearly twice the usual rate (149 on 17 raiders).
0:49 with Shazzrah in the same fight. Yulepunch's Living Bomb killed Firetoad at 0:37. 32 Shazzrah's Curses removed by Firetoad, Orbywan and Osinir.
0:36, no deaths. 2 of 5 Dark Mendings kicked (Shaaw, Terrora), and Hand of Ragnaros did three times its usual share of damage.
0:50 (median 1:08), no deaths. Macharius took 56 Elemental Fires and Hjärterkung 10.
